scenarios.name: enters-and-burns-an-opponent-creature
scenarios.why: When Flametongue Kavu enters it deals 4 damage to target creature: with the player's pick aimed at the opponent's Bear, the 2/2 dies and the Kavu stays.

scenarios.name: only-legal-target-is-itself
scenarios.why: The ETB must target a creature; when the Kavu is the only creature on the battlefield the fallback targets it and the Kavu dies to its own entry burn (a state-based action with 4 damage on a 4/2).
